blind_read: The big monkey points at a chart while the small one turns its map right-side up.

evidence.observation: The pointing finger touches the lower part of the upside-down route while the small helper reaches toward the bottom edge. Both characters have their own tail.
The sheet tips diagonally in the helper's hands and settles with the tree at the top, inside a stationary easel. The green tree and red route keep their colors in teal.
